mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing 60 degree temperatures with clear skies at Fireman Park, but be mindful of the moderate air quality index of 51.
City Hall has posted multiple election notices regarding the November general election, and the engineering department has updated their list of reports available for public review.

Today, enjoy live music at Bailey Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmers Market and more live music at Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, the Ironman Loop Festival comes to town this Saturday.
On Sunday, August 30, the school district informed the Verona Police Department of an inappropriate relationship involving a staff member, which led to an arrest for sexual assault of a child.
Today is the perfect day to stop by for a scoop of Raspberry Cheesecake, as Culver opens today at 10 AM.
